blocks.html: Caisson piles shall consist of a shaft section of concrete or grout-filled pipe, extending to bedrock, with an uncased socket drilled into bedrock of Class 1c or better and filled with concrete or grout. The caisson pile shall have a full-length structural steel core, full length steel reinforcing, or a stub core or steel reinforcing installed in the rock socket and extending into the pipe portion a distance equal to the socket depth. The minimum outside diameter of the caisson pile shall be 7 inches (177.8 mm), and the diameter of the rock socket shall be approximately equal to the inside diameter of the caisson pile.
